[[Chormar]] is a [[collector]], a type of [[Non-player character|NPC]] that exchanges [[Trophy|trophies]] for [[armor]].

== Locations==
* [[Istan]]
** {{NPC location|Lahtenda Bog}} (south-west of [[Blacktide Den]], near the [[mandragor]] [[boss]], [[Najab Lifedrinker]].)
